A model name is matched by the longest listed name that is a prefix of the observed or configured name (tier and effort suffixes such as -medium, -high, -low, -tiered-high are dropped first). Check every value against the vendor pages before relying on it; this table is NOT the Claude price table (scripts/model-prices.json, policies/model-policy.md section 6).
